name: Airfoil Design Simulation Challenge
description: Develop machine learning surrogate models to predict steady-state 2D velocity fields, pressure fields, turbulent viscosity, and derived aerodynamic coefficients around airfoils, approximating high-fidelity CFD simulations.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: The input data consists of airfoil geometry represented as an unstructured mesh, boundary conditions, angle of attack (AOA), and numerical simulation data including positions, inlet velocity, distance to the airfoil, and normals. For example, an input might include a mesh file for the airfoil, AOA=5 degrees, and velocity components at various spatial positions.
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output includes predictions for steady-state 2D velocity fields (ux, uy), pressure divided by specific mass (ps), turbulent kinematic viscosity (nu_t), and derived aerodynamic coefficients (cd, cl). Values are continuous and must adhere to physical constraints.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for each airfoil sample, e.g., airfoil_001

field.name: ps
field.description: predicted pressure divided by specific mass (Pa/kg)

cr:evaluation.notes: The Global Score is a weighted linear combination of ML performance, physics compliance, and OOD generalization scores. MSE is minimized, while other metrics like Speedup and Spearman correlation are maximized. Speedup is normalized using log10 scaling.
